summaryZh: Breen Lab 当前研究 SARS-CoV-2 的炎症与氧调控响应，以及 N-聚糖在外周氧输送中的作用。页面描述建立体内小鼠模型，研究运动训练和慢性肺病中的氧供应。
researchQuestions: 运动训练和慢性肺病中，氧如何供应给骨骼肌线粒体？

evidence.quote: developed several in vivo mouse models to understand how O 2 is made available to skeletal muscle mitochondria in response to exercise training and chronic pulmonary disease.

Currently, the lab has two major projects: It aims to understand the inflammatory and O2 regulatory response to SARS-CoV-2 and how this may be attenuated by IL-33 and IL-1ß protein modulators. To understand the role of N-glycans in peripheral O 2 transport.
